title: Asset
description: Schema for the MEDIATE Asset entity. An Asset represents a protected or monitored system component registered in the Service Manager registry. It includes asset type, an underAlert flag, associated Sentinel, last assessment timestamp, registration timestamp, and asset components.

type.description: NGSI-LD entity type. It has to be asset.

assetType.description: Property. Type or category of the protected asset.

underAlert.description: Property. Flag indicating whether the asset is currently under alert. Replaces the previously used operationalStatus and riskLevel, which could not be derived from the current data model.

associatedSentinel.description: Relationship. Sentinel entity associated with this asset.

lastAssessmentTimestamp.description: Property. Date and time of the latest assessment associated with this asset.

registrationTimestamp.description: Property. Date and time at which the asset was registered in the Service Manager registry.

assetComponents.description: Property. Static snapshot of software, firmware, hardware, or system components associated with the asset. This information can support CTI integration and asset-level querying.

identifierType.description: Type of identifier used for the asset component. Examples include cpe and purl.

identifier.description: Component identifier value, for example a CPE URI or a package URL.
